The petitions registered as M.V.C.No.1368/2020 and M.V.C.No.1369/2020 filed by Venkataraju and Nirmal Kumar Nayak under Section 166 of IMV Act are hereby partly allowed.
In M.V.C.No.1368/2020 the respondent No.1 shall pay Rs.16,92,033/- with current and future interest at 6% p.a., to the petitioner towards compensation.
In M.V.C.No.1369/2020 the respondent No.1 shall pay Rs.2,26,560/- with current and future interest at 6% p.a., to the petitioner towards compensation.
In both the cases respondent No.1 shall deposit the compensation amount with interest within 3 months from today.

In both the cases, after deposit of the compensation amount, entire compensation amount and interest may be released to the petitioners by crediting the same to their respective bank accounts directly.
In both the cases, petition filed by the petitioners against respondent No.2/insurance company is dismissed.
